name: seeded-email
question: You are the president of the student council. Write an email to your principal, Mr Lim, proposing a Reading Corner in the school canteen. In your email you should: explain why the corner is needed; describe how it would work; explain how the cost would be kept low; say how the school would benefit. Write in a formal and persuasive tone.
